summary: The root W-S-L relates to seeking to get at or obtain something, like water with a bucket. It also means to seek nearness or access to someone, or to gain their favor, by means of something.
lane: 5 تَوَسَّلَ بِالدَّلْوِ إِلَى المَآءِ ذ [ He sought to get at, or obtain, the water by means of the bucket ]. (M in art. دلو .) -b2- تَوَسَّلَ إِلَيْهِ بِكَذَا He sought to bring himself near to him, or to approach to him, to gain access to him, or to advance himself in his favour, by such a thing: (Msb, &c.:) so too ; (S, K;) and , aor. يَسِلُ . (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: A means of access to a thing; a means of becoming near to a thing; a means of becoming near to

a means of becoming near to a thing:
(IAth, Msb:) these are the primary significations: (IAth:)
a means of becoming near to,

headwords.def: وَسِيلَةٌ A means of access to a thing; (IAth;) a means of becoming near to a thing: (IAth, Msb:) these are the primary significations: (IAth:) a means of becoming near to, or intimate with, or of ingratiating oneself with, another: (S:) honourable rank or station with a king: degree: affinity: (K:) a tie, or connexion: (TA:) it may be rendered a means of access, nearness, intimacy, ingratiating oneself, attachment, or connexion: and also, of attainment, or accomplishment.
